Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe C2-1, Motor
Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-L in the
area bound by:



       West Irving Park Road, a line 280 feet east of and parallel to North Central Avenue; the
       public alley next south of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; a line 131.34 feet south
       of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; and, North Central Avenue


to those of a Bl-1, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after Its passage and publication.




                                                            Nicholas Sposato
                                                            Alderman, 38th Ward




Common Address:
5555 West Irving Park Road
